mainEntity.name: How much does a wrongful termination lawyer cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for a wrongful termination lawyer can vary. Many wrongful termination cases are handled on a contingency fee basis, meaning the lawyer only gets paid if you win your case, receiving a percentage of the settlement or award. Some lawyers may charge hourly rates or a retainer, particularly for initial consultations. It's important to discuss fee arrangements upfront during your consultation.
